# Anime Upscaler GUI & anime-sr

> Anime super-resolution and anime upscaling toolkit in PyTorch: a standalone Windows GUI for image and video upscaling, plus a research/training package with SPAN, Mamba, ERANet, AnimeSR, Real-ESRGAN and distilled lightweight students.

- Repository: https://github.com/alshahia/upscale_anime
- Branch: release/gui-preview
- Released artifact: v0.2.0-preview (GitHub pre-release; the wheel is not on PyPI)
- License: MIT (the repository; vendored model code keeps its upstream licenses, see the GUI NOTICE file)

## Docs

- [README (English)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/alshahia/upscale_anime/release/gui-preview/README.md): overview, GUI install, research pipeline, benchmarks, project status.

- [GUI README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/alshahia/upscale_anime/release/gui-preview/apps/anime_upscaler_gui/README.md): GUI walkthrough, supported models, shortcuts, extension recipes.

## Installation

- GUI (Windows): download https://github.com/alshahia/upscale_anime/releases/download/v0.2.0-preview/anime_upscaler_gui-0.2.0-py3-none-any.whl and https://github.com/alshahia/upscale_anime/releases/download/v0.2.0-preview/SHA256SUMS.txt, then `python -m venv .venv-anime-gui` and `.venv-anime-gui\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install anime_upscaler_gui-0.2.0-py3-none-any.whl`. Requires ffmpeg and ffprobe on PATH for video. No model weights are bundled.
- Research package: clone the repository, create a virtual environment, run `pip install -e ".[dev]"`; optional extras: `pip install -e ".[api]"`, `pip install -e ".[mamba]"`. Requires Python 3.12+ and PyTorch 2.4+.
- Self-check after installing the GUI: `anime-upscaler-gui --self-check` (prints JSON: version, ffmpeg, ffprobe, bundled_registry, architectures).

## Usage

- Headless inference: `anime-sr infer --checkpoint checkpoints/model_best.pt --input ./input_images --output ./output --scale 4 --device cuda` (add `--tta` or `--tile 512` if needed).
- GUI: launch `anime-upscaler-gui` (or from a source checkout, see the GUI README).
- API server: `anime-sr serve --config configs/api/default.yaml --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000`.
- Test commands: `pytest`, `pytest apps/anime_upscaler_gui/tests -q`, `pytest tests/release -q`, `python -m mkdocs build --strict`.

## Research

- [Training guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/alshahia/upscale_anime/release/gui-preview/docs/training.md): training procedures, distillation losses, configuration.
- [Model architectures](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/alshahia/upscale_anime/release/gui-preview/docs/models.md): SPAN, Mamba-PAN, RFDN, TinySRVGG, MambaIRv2 details.
- [CLI reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/alshahia/upscale_anime/release/gui-preview/docs/cli.md) and [configuration](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/alshahia/upscale_anime/release/gui-preview/docs/configuration.md).
- [Measured status 2026-11-16](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/alshahia/upscale_anime/release/gui-preview/docs/status/MEASURED_STATUS_2026-11-16.md): raw release-day measurement snapshot.
- [v7 results](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/alshahia/upscale_anime/release/gui-preview/docs/v7_results.md), [v8 results](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/alshahia/upscale_anime/release/gui-preview/docs/v8_results.md), [RFDN real-time report](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/alshahia/upscale_anime/release/gui-preview/docs/rfdn_realtime_report.md).
- Methods: progressive ensemble distillation, MTKD + FAKD, SPAN-Tiny teacher, Mamba-PAN, RFDN/TinySRVGG students. All reported numbers are project-reported single-machine measurements, not an independent benchmark suite.
